subject: Solent Analytics — Pilot activation checkpoint & observability guardrails
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@solent.io>, Liam O'Connor <liam@solent.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-12T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposal for pilot activation checkpoint

Hi Asha / Liam —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. I wanted to capture the key pain points, the outcomes you care about, and a proposed minimal scope for a first 30-day pilot so we can align on owners and access. Short and actionable below.

Key pain points (as we heard)
- Inconsistent latency spikes during batch inference on your current stack leading to timeouts in production feeds.
- High per-token cost for reranking/semantic search workloads at 50k QPS-equivalent month.
- Limited observability into per-route latency and token-level cost attribution (hard to justify infra spend).

Primary pilot goals (success criteria)
1) Stable 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for the search reranker for 1k qps sustained.
2) Demonstrate >= 25% reduction in per-token inference cost via batching + prefix caching for the reranker workload.
3) Deliver end-to-end observability: per-route latency, per-request token counts, and a dashboard for alerts.

Proposed 30-day scope (minimal viable activation)
- Model: Hosted Redwood-optimized reranker variant (rwd-rank-1.3-q8) with prefix cache enabled.
- Traffic pattern: Run synthetic replay of representative traffic (we'll provide a 48-hour capture + loader) and a small live shadow stream.
- Metrics & evals: Prompt set of 120 reranker queries (you provided) + automated A/B quality check vs current model (NDCG@10 target: within 3% of baseline).
- Owners: Jordan (engagement lead), Kimberly (SRE lead), Sergio (solutions/integration). On your side: Asha (product), Liam (infra).
- Access: Requesting service account for S3 access to the capture, temporary IAM role for metrics export, and allowlist of IPs for the private preview. See attached access checklist.
- Deliverables by day 30: performance report, cost breakdown, and an observability dashboard with alert rules.

Next steps (this week)
1) Asha: confirm the 48-hour capture location or share credentials for our loader (by Tue 2025-06-17).
2) Jordan/Kimberly: provision a sandbox Dedicated pool and share onboarding steps (by Wed 2025-06-18).
3) Liam/Sergio: quick network/allowlist call to validate VPC routing (30 mins) — propose Thu 2025-06-19 09:00 PT.

Attachments: solent_poc_scope_v1.pdf (scope doc), redwood-access-checklist.xlsx (access steps & required credentials).

If anything above looks off, flag it here and we'll adjust. Otherwise we'll treat this as the working plan and kick off provisioning.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

From: Asha Patel <asha@solent.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@solent.io>
Date: 2025-06-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposal for pilot activation checkpoint

Thanks Jordan — this is great and captures the call. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 48-hour capture is stored in our S3 bucket bucket-solent-prod/analysis/poc-capture-202506 (we'll create a short-lived key).
- We're comfortable with the target latency and the NDCG@10 delta — product will validate samples once you run the first pass.
- On cost: finance wants a projected cost-per-1M-requests estimate for the proposed config before we finalize (rough ballpark is fine at this stage).

We'll aim to:
- Share an access key for S3 by Mon 2025-06-16 EOD.
- Liam will join the allowlist call on Thu 9:00 PT.

Also tagging a small internal ask: can the observability dashboard include token-level cost per route + an annotated timeline of config changes (so we can point to regressions)?

Asha
Asha Patel
Head of Product, Solent Analytics
asha@solent.io

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@solent.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-17T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposal for pilot activation checkpoint — prep notes

Thanks Asha — this is in scope. A couple implementation notes before the allowlist call:

- For the replay loader we'll need S3 GET access and a small manifest file (jsonl) that maps source files to replay timestamps. If you can't provide a manifest we can generate one but it adds one day.
- Observability: we'll wire token-level cost tagging via our request middleware. We'll propose a dashboard template that includes: 95/99 latency, P50, token histogram, cost-per-route, and regression annotations.
- Cost projection: Ben will produce a conservative estimate (batching at 64, qkv quantization) and a stress projection. Expect an initial estimate by Tue 2025-06-18 COB.

Proposed short agenda for Thu 2025-06-19 09:00 PT (30 mins)
1) Quick network checklist & allowlist verification (Liam, Kimberly) — 8 mins
2) Replay manifest and loader expectations (Asha, Sergio) — 8 mins
3) Observability telemetry and required exports (Jordan, Ben) — 8 mins
4) Confirm timeline & owners, and call out any blockers — 6 mins

I'll set up the calendar invite and include a short Miro of the data flow.

— Sergio
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

- Blocking item: internal procurement requested an acceptance signature on a short SOW for the sandbox Dedicated pool. Asha to route to finance; Jordan to share SOW link.
